headline: Habiganj: Section 144 imposed amid BNP-NCP tensions
summary: Authorities have banned all gatherings to maintain law and order in the district following political friction between the BNP and NCP.
details: Authorities in Habiganj have imposed Section 144, banning all public gatherings and assemblies. The move comes as tensions rise between the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) and the Nationalist Party (NCP).
The restriction is aimed at preventing potential clashes and maintaining law and order across the district.
Local administration and security forces have been deployed to monitor the situation and ensure the ban is strictly enforced.

headline: 5 Bangladeshi women return home after serving jail terms in India
summary: The women were repatriated to Bangladesh after completing their legal sentences in Indian prisons.
details: Five Bangladeshi women have returned to Bangladesh after completing their prison sentences in India.
The women were handed over to Bangladeshi authorities upon their return.
The repatriation process follows the completion of their respective jail terms in Indian correctional facilities.
They have now been reunited with their families after serving their legal sentences abroad.
